record.question: Who was a dissident Congress leader recently sworn-in as the ninth Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh?
record.explanation: Answer B: Kaliko Pul. Kalikho Pul was sworn in as Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister on 19 February 2016 after President's Rule was revoked. Parliament's contemporary constitutional chronicle records that event. Option B's Kaliko is a spelling defect but the identity is clear. Historical/source note: Historical February 2016 swearing-in; he was no longer Chief Minister by the October examination. Preserve printed Kaliko spelling. Reference: https://eparlib.sansad.in/bitstream/123456789/58528/1/JPI_June_2016.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
